name: molecular_quadrature
scope: CPU/CUDA quadrature shares rational and Treutler primals and AD Jacobians. Legendre Newton slopes are JVPs of the polynomial recurrence; consumer stopping and final-slope policies remain distinct. CUDA retains one rational transform per atom/radial pair, reused distances, Becke graph lowering, bounded tiles and exact allocation accounting. Native code owns storage, execution and exports.
